symbols.name: tail vertex
symbols.meaning: The vertex at which an edge starts, a source, gate or sink of the network.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be vertices joined by an edge from $u$ to $v$, where a vertex is a source, gate or sink of the network.

symbols.name: head vertex
symbols.meaning: The vertex at which an edge ends, a source, gate or sink of the network.
symbols.quote: Let $u$ and $v$ be vertices joined by an edge from $u$ to $v$, where a vertex is a source, gate or sink of the network.

symbols.name: frame
symbols.meaning: The invertible linear operator that is the frame of vertex $v$, acting on arrays indexed by the common address set.
symbols.quote: The frame $D_v$ is an invertible linear operator on the space of arrays indexed by the common address set, and all incidences of one gate share its frame.

symbols.name: logical array
symbols.meaning: The array a role carries in the logical interpretation, before it is stored through the frame.
symbols.quote: If $g$ is the logical array, the stored array is $D_v g$.

relations.quote: A frame of a vertex is an invertible linear operator attached to a gate or terminal in a [Linear network](linear-network.md) that fixes how the array on each wire there is stored.
